summary.key_theme: 串流媒體市場競爭加劇與成長放緩的擔憂，與競爭對手併購帶來的潛在市場重組機會並存。

bullish.title: Paramount paid Netflix $2.8 billion to walk away from its $82.7-billion Warner Bros. deal — and Netflix stock jumped 14%
bullish.reason: Netflix 獲得高達 28 億美元的賠償金，顯著增強現金流，且市場對此利多反應正面，股價單日上漲 14 %。

bullish.title: TD Cowen Reiterates Buy on Netflix, Maintains $100 Price Target
bullish.reason: 分析師 John Blackledge 維持買入評級與 100 美元目標價，顯示專業機構對其長期價值仍具信心。

bullish.title: Disney Licenses Major Movie and Show Franchises to Netflix
bullish.reason: 透過與 Disney 達成授權協議，Netflix 擴充了內容庫，有助於提升用戶黏著度與競爭力。

bullish.title: Paramount-Warner Merger Closes: Why Disney and Netflix Are Better Stocks
bullish.reason: 分析指出競爭對手 Paramount 因併購背負高額債務，相較之下 Netflix 的財務體質更為穩健，具備投資優勢。

bullish.title: Don't Sell Netflix: NFLX Is the One Streaming Pick I'd Add to Today
bullish.reason: 強調儘管近期股價疲軟，但 Netflix 的長期成長潛力與市場地位依然穩固，建議投資人逢低布局。

bullish.title: NFLX Price Predictions 2027: How Netflix Stock Could Hit $100 Next Year
bullish.reason: BMO Capital Markets 看好 Netflix 明年股價翻倍，為市場提供正面預期。

bullish.title: Netflix (NFLX) Surpasses Market Returns: Some Facts Worth Knowing
bullish.reason: 近期股價表現優於大盤，顯示在波動市場中具備一定的抗跌性與反彈動能。

bearish.title: Netflix Stock Plunges 26.8% Year to Date: 3 Key Reasons to Stay Away
bearish.reason: 年初至今股價重挫 26.8 %，主要受成長放緩、內容成本上升及高估值壓力影響，市場情緒轉趨保守。

bearish.title: Netflix’s Own Co-CEO Just Warned of Slowing Growth
bearish.reason: 共同執行長 Sarandos 親口承認成長放緩，直接打擊投資人信心，並引發後續評級下調。

bearish.title: Are Rising Live Sports Costs a Margin Threat to Netflix Stockholders?
bearish.reason: 直播體育賽事權利金支出過高，恐壓縮利潤空間，對長期獲利能力構成挑戰。

bearish.title: YouTube's Lead Over Netflix in TV Viewing Keeps Growing. Is Netflix Stock a Sell?
bearish.reason: YouTube 在電視觀看時數的市占率持續超越 Netflix，顯示用戶流失風險增加。

bearish.title: 1 Number That Might Explain Why Netflix (NFLX) Stock Is Down 27% in 2026
bearish.reason: 指出 Netflix 已進入成熟期，成長動能減弱是導致股價今年下跌 27 % 的核心因素。

bearish.title: Is Netflix’s (NFLX) Free Cash Flow Keeping Pace With Its Reported Earnings?
bearish.reason: 質疑自由現金流與財報獲利之間的關聯性，暗示財務品質可能存在隱憂。

bearish.title: Is Netflix (NFLX) Stock a Buy?
bearish.reason: 儘管過去表現優異，但文章強調成長放緩的現實，對未來股價表現持保留態度。

bearish.title: Netflix's Newest Rival Has Nearly $70 Billion in Annual Sales
bearish.reason: Paramount 與 Warner Bros. 合併後規模龐大，對 Netflix 構成更強大的競爭壓力。

neutral.title: Netflix (NFLX) Gains Breathing Room As A Major Studio Merger Closes
neutral.reason: 報導競爭對手合併後的市場格局變化，對 Netflix 而言既是挑戰也是市場重組的契機，影響中性。

neutral.title: Skydance Sinks 8% a Day After Completing Warner Bros. Discovery Acquisition; Netflix Holds Flat
neutral.reason: Netflix 股價持平，顯示市場在重大併購案後對其反應冷靜，未有明顯方向。

neutral.title: If You Invested $100 In Netflix Stock 15 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
neutral.reason: 純粹回顧過去 15 年的績效表現，不涉及當前基本面變化，對股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Paramount Will Be Risky After Warner Deal; Disney, Netflix Look Like Better Bets
neutral.reason: 與其他報導內容重複，主要強調競爭對手風險，對 Netflix 本身無新資訊。
